Long-duration electricity storage: coupled voltage, inventory, area and cost
ROOT,12November2026Brisbane. Conditional original engineering contracts, not a measured storage device, factory quote or validated cell model. No producer library/code/artifact was collected or executed and no physical experiment was performed.

1. Retained heat-engine scope
The complete available retractable-sodium/Stirling/resident-jaw candidate is a conditional physical design. The source-reported nominal100W/.350115 efficiency point has only.09429W hot-input margin; restart, tolerances and an unqualified engine-map transfer defeat that nominal result. The full model predicts immediate OFF peaks1.63--4.15W, an actually withdrawn period shorter than the nondelivery interval, and no daily35% operation. Its imposed store-output trajectory is not closed under the final active-length audit.
Its$183.04/100W production ledger becomes$104.90 even if all$47.23 insulation stock is free and the$61.82 engine cost is halved, with other terms unchanged. This is ledger deletion, not an all-engine cost lower bound. Its conditional long-duration storage budgets do not establish actual delivery or a physical cost advantage. The integration, complete thermal-inventory method, paid stock/yield and calorimetry remain useful at that scope.

For a simplified disconnect with restart heat Es, OFF length H and steady leakage q, withdrawal saves heat over constant stopped leakage q0 only if q0>q+Es/H, before other actuator/electrical terms. At Es200Wh,q1W this is15.286W for14h and2.389W for144h. The producer's more complete thresholds15.84/2.49W are consistent with additional paid terms. A better heat leak alone need not repay the physical closure.

2. A different full useful operation and joint target
Consider electrically rechargeable storage that accepts ordinary electricity, waits144h, then delivers100W net regulatedAC for100h, with a declared charge period<=100h and peak input<=2times rated output. Its useful energy is10kWh after the hold. A100kW/10MWh plant is a production-cost reference, not built hardware. A research target of>=65% fullACround-trip efficiency and<=15USD per USEFUL deliveredkWh installed is not supplied performance. Other mechanisms and geometries can change these screens.
